visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Odd or Even
visualizerParams.description: Use the remainder operator to decide whether each number from 1 to 6 is even or odd.

tests.pattern:
(?<![\s\S])\s*1 is odd[ 	]*?
2 is even[ 	]*?
3 is odd[ 	]*?
4 is even[ 	]*?
5 is odd[ 	]*?
6 is even\s*(?![\s\S])
